news.headline: Leerink Partners Initiates Nektar Therapeutics at Outperform With $130 Target; UBS Starts at Neutral
news.summary: Leerink began coverage at Outperform with a $130 target, calling Nektar a top emerging name in immunology. UBS initiated the same day at Neutral with a $53 target, citing the long wait until the mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout.

news.headline: BTIG Reiterates Buy on Nektar Therapeutics With $178 Price Target
news.summary: BTIG kept its Buy rating and $178 target after the EADV sell-off, citing physician market research that sees safety as rezpeg's key differentiator in atopic dermatitis and alopecia. The firm expects the Lilly award to come to roughly $130-140 million once interest is included.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Shares Drop After Rezpegaldesleukin Trial Results on Alopecia Areata
news.summary: NKTR fell about 22% to an eight-month low on the EADV data day. Investors focused on the fade in alopecia response off drug, from 75% at four months to 63% at six months, rather than the deepening hair regrowth.

news.headline: New Rezpegaldesleukin Data Supporting Long-term Durability and Disease Improvement in Patients with Alopecia Areata and Atopic Dermatitis at EADV Congress 2026
news.summary: In REZOLVE-AA, SALT<=20 responses held in 75% of responders at four months and 63% at six months off treatment, and SALT<=10 rose from 7% at week 52 to 19%. In AD maintenance, complete clearance (EASI-100) rose to 22% with monthly and 18% with quarterly dosing by week 52. Nektar also said the third Phase 3 study, ZENITH AD-3 in treatment-experienced patients, has started.

news.headline: Nektar Wins $90 Million Jury Verdict Against Eli Lilly in Rezpeg Dispute
news.summary: After five days of deliberation, the N.D. Cal. jury found on September 24 that Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing and awarded $90 million plus interest. It rejected the claim that Lilly breached its express commercially reasonable efforts obligation, so the award is only about 9% of the nearly $1 billion Nektar sought, and post-trial motions and appeals remain possible.

news.headline: Lilly Owes Nektar $1B If It Breached Rezpeg Deal, Jury Told
news.summary: Nektar's damages expert told the jury that Eli Lilly could owe nearly $1 billion if it breached the rezpeg license and co-development agreement. That framing set expectations far above the $90 million the jury eventually awarded.

catalysts.label: Post-trial rulings in Nektar v. Eli Lilly (judgment, interest, appeals)
catalysts.detail: The jury awarded $90 million plus interest on September 24; with simple interest the gross amount is estimated at about $115 million (BTIG sees $130-140 million), but the court still has to set interest and enter judgment. Post-trial motions from either side and a possible appeal could change or delay the payment, and a settlement is also possible. It is a modest cash add to the ~$1 billion balance, not a valuation driver.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: The first report after the Lilly verdict and EADV data should update cash against the ~$1.02 billion June balance and full-year R&D guidance of $210-230 million. It should also give enrollment updates for all three ZENITH AD Phase 3 studies and explain how the Lilly award will be accounted for. Data aggregators estimate Thursday, November 5 after the close, but Nektar has not yet announced the date.

catalysts.label: Start of a clinical study in an additional autoimmune indication
catalysts.detail: Management committed to starting a clinical study in a further autoimmune indication before the end of 2026, to broaden the Treg mechanism beyond atopic dermatitis, alopecia areata and type 1 diabetes. The indication has not been disclosed. The February 2026 UCSF multiple sclerosis research collaboration is the most-cited guess. This adds pipeline optionality rather than driving valuation.

catalysts.label: First NKTR-0165 (TNFR2 agonist) preclinical data at a scientific conference
catalysts.detail: Management guided to presenting preclinical data for NKTR-0165, its bivalent TNFR2 agonist antibody, at a scientific conference in the second half of 2026. It is the only meaningful pipeline asset behind rezpeg. No venue or date has been named, so it could slip into 2027.

catalysts.label: 52-week off-treatment atopic dermatitis data
catalysts.detail: Management guided to 52-week off-treatment atopic dermatitis data in Q1 2027 to inform long-term maintenance dosing while the ZENITH AD Phase 3s enroll. After the market punished the fading alopecia off-drug responses, this dataset is the next test of whether rezpeg can be dosed far less often than incumbent biologics.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AA Phase 3 alopecia areata study start (~850 patients)
catalysts.detail: Nektar confirmed at EADV that the single registrational ZENITH AA study, about 850 patients, starts in early 2027, with SALT<=20 at week 52 as the primary endpoint. It builds on REZOLVE-AA, where 63% of responders kept SALT<=20 six months off drug. Rezpeg has FDA Fast Track in this indication, and the readout is guided to the second half of 2029.

catalysts.label: Initial Phase 2 type 1 diabetes data (TrialNet collaboration)
catalysts.detail: Initial data are expected in 2027 from the TrialNet-run Phase 2 placebo-controlled study of rezpegaldesleukin in about 70 adults and children with new-onset stage 3 type 1 diabetes. Nektar supplies drug while TrialNet funds and runs the trial, so the cost is minimal while the upside is large. A positive C-peptide preservation signal would extend the Treg thesis well beyond dermatology.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout (mid-2028)
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis is the decisive binary event for the stock. All three studies (AD-1, AD-2 and, since about October 1, AD-3 in treatment-experienced patients) are now running, roughly 1,530 patients in total. Cash runway extends into Q3 2028, so Nektar reaches this readout without another raise.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Nektar has guided to a first BLA for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in 2029, after the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The Phase 3 program was designed with EMA scientific advice in parallel, so a European marketing application is planned from the same dataset.

pulse: At ~$36 (Oct 16) NKTR has roughly halved since mid-September: the jury awarded only $90 million (about $115 million with interest) against Eli Lilly versus the ~$1 billion sought, and the stock fell 22% on October 1 when alopecia responses faded off drug. The fundamentals have not broken, since all three ZENITH AD Phase 3s are running, AD maintenance responses deepened and ~$1 billion of cash funds the company past the mid-2028 readout, so cash now makes up a large share of the market cap. The Street remains split (BTIG $178 and Leerink $130 versus UBS Neutral at $53), and the next checkpoints are Q3 results in early November and 52-week off-treatment AD data in Q1 2027.
